briefdescription.para: Metadata - Debug info sections or other metadata.
Exclude - This section will be excluded from the final executable or shared library.

detaileddescription.para: Only valid for ELF / COFF targets.

briefdescription.para: Text - Text section, used for functions and other executable code.
ExecuteOnly, Text section that is not readable.
ReadOnly - Data that is never written to at program runtime by the program or the dynamic linker.

detaileddescription.para: Things in the top-level readonly SectionKind are not mergeable.

briefdescription.para: MergableCString - Any null-terminated string which allows merging.

detaileddescription.para: These values are known to end in a nul value of the specified size, not otherwise contain a nul value, and be mergable. This allows the linker to unique the strings if it so desires. Mergeable1ByteCString - 1 byte mergable, null terminated, string.

briefdescription.para: Mergeable2ByteCString - 2 byte mergable, null terminated, string.
Mergeable4ByteCString - 4 byte mergable, null terminated, string.
MergeableConst - These are sections for merging fixed-length constants together.

detaileddescription.para: For example, this can be used to unique constant pool entries etc. MergeableConst4 - This is a section used by 4-byte constants, for example, floats.

briefdescription.para: MergeableConst8 - This is a section used by 8-byte constants, for example, doubles.
MergeableConst16 - This is a section used by 16-byte constants, for example, vectors.
MergeableConst32 - This is a section used by 32-byte constants, for example, vectors.
Writeable - This is the base of all segments that need to be written to during program runtime.

detaileddescription.para: ThreadLocal - This is the base of all TLS segments. All TLS objects must be writeable, otherwise there is no reason for them to be thread local! ThreadBSS - Zero-initialized TLS data objects.

briefdescription.para: ThreadData - Initialized TLS data objects.
ThreadBSSLocal - Zero-initialized TLS data objects with local linkage.
GlobalWriteableData - Writeable data that is global (not thread local).
BSSLocal - This is BSS (zero initialized and writable) data which has local linkage.
BSSExtern - This is BSS data with normal external linkage.
Common - Data with common linkage.

detaileddescription.para: These represent tentative definitions, which always have a zero initializer and are never marked 'constant'.

briefdescription.para: This is writeable data that has a non-zero initializer.

ReadOnlyWithRel - These are global variables that are never written to by the program, but that have relocations, so they must be stuck in a writeable section so that the dynamic linker can write to them.

detaileddescription.para: If it chooses to, the dynamic linker can mark the pages these globals end up on as read-only after it is done with its relocation phase.

briefdescription.para: SectionKind - This is a simple POD value that classifies the properties of a section.

detaileddescription.para: A section is classified into the deepest possible classification, and then the target maps them onto their sections based on what capabilities they have.
The comments below describe these as if they were an inheritance hierarchy in order to explain the predicates below.
